# Today Is Friday — NOTE4C sample

Unmodified merged firmware from [eyaeya/today-is-friday v0.1.2](https://github.com/eyaeya/today-is-friday/releases/tag/v0.1.2).

Target: NOTE4C, ESP32-S3, 400×300 four-color panel. Interface: Chinese. First boot offers Wi-Fi and time setup; the app then displays a playful calendar. This is community firmware, not factory or consumer firmware.

The included binary was verified against the upstream SHA256SUMS. Only the merged image is included; SHA256SUMS also lists other upstream release assets.

Firmware: MIT, see LICENSE. Embedded Source Han Sans SC font: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see SourceHanSansSC-OFL-1.1.txt.
